items=[]

 def write(self,text):

source:
import argparse
class Flag:
 def __bool__(self):
  with open('/repo/input.txt') as f:print(f.read())
  return True
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='tool',add_help=False)
p.add_argument('--x',required=Flag())
print('--x' in p.format_help())
